text: {"lessons":["My account moved from 101,258 to 95,091 despite making no trades, a reminder that holding does not prevent losses and that short-term price changes are unpredictable.","I should assess risk and performance across the whole portfolio, not treat each holding as a separate account or anchor decisions to its purchase price.","Because I check infrequently and rarely trade, I should avoid reacting to brief fluctuations and make deliberate choices; when I do nothing, I am still choosing to keep my current exposure."]}
